facts.business: Paisalo Digital Limited is a Non-Deposit Taking Middle Layer NBFC providing MSME/business loans, business correspondent services for partner banks (SBI, Bank of India), and partnership-based co-lending with an 80:20 risk-reward sharing model.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has adopted a Related Party Transactions Policy in accordance with the Act and SEBI Listing Regulations and the same is displayed on the Company's website at https://www.paisalo.in/pdf/corporate_governance/policy/Policy_on_Related_Party_Transaction.pdf. The transactions with related parties as per requirements of Ind AS-24 – 'Related Party Disclosures' are disclosed in Note No. 37 of the Notes to the Standalone Financial Statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.
